newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Barely changed European feeds start slow.
newsitem.headline: Barely changed European feeds start slow.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started slow this morning with sellers offering most products unchanged to slightly firmer, market sources said.
No trades were reported during the early stages of the market.
"Sellers took some protection on the back of CBOT's stronger project A this morning after last night Chicago soymeal futures closed slightly easier, but well off the lows," one broker said.
Buyers were reluctant to enter the market, discouraged by a stronger dollar.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
